top_signals.title: Australian Dollar’s Top Forecasters Say Winning Run Likely Over
top_signals.summary: The Australian dollar’s two-month rally may be nearing a peak, with some of its top forecasters warning that bets on another central bank interest-rate hike have gone too far.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
